{{Quote|Watcher Two is one of our finest analysts, a success from the government eugenics programs. Her brain is faster than most computers.|Keeper|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''eugenics program''' was a genetics project maintained by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that produced [[Watcher (Imperial Intelligence)|Watchers]], highly intelligent supervisory operatives for [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. [[Shara Jenn|Watcher Two]] and [[Watcher Seven]] were among the Watchers produced by the program; subjects were the result of generations of selective breeding, mental programming, and mental improvements.
